name: @exaudeus/memory-mcp

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Start of conversation — call once to load context for a project. Returns stored preferences, gotchas overview, stale entries needing review, and entry counts. Example: {"lobe": "default"} Surfaces everything previously saved via learn/gotcha/convention/prefer. Call once at session start. Results stay valid for the entire conversation — no need to re-call.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Before starting a task, surface prior knowledge you haven't loaded yet. Searches stored memory using semantic + keyword matching. Example: {"context": "auth token refresh", "lobe": "default"} Searches YOUR memory entries (from learn/gotcha/convention/prefer). Does NOT search the codebase or the internet. Call once per area. Skip if you already recalled this topic or received it from brief(). Knowledge stays in your context. Required param: "context" — the area you need knowledge about.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

context.description: The topic or area you need knowledge about. Describe in natural language — e.g. "auth token refresh", "how modules communicate", "payment webhook handler".

tools.name: gotchas
tools.description: Before making changes to an area, check for known pitfalls. Retrieves stored gotchas, optionally filtered. Example: {"lobe": "default", "area": "auth"} or {"lobe": "default"} for all. brief() already includes a gotchas overview. Use this when you need gotchas for a specific area not covered in the briefing.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: conventions
tools.description: Before writing new code, check how this codebase does things. Retrieves stored conventions, optionally filtered. Example: {"lobe": "default", "area": "testing"} or {"lobe": "default"} for all. recall() also surfaces conventions. Use this for focused convention lookup, recall() for broader cross-topic search.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: gotcha
tools.description: When something surprises you or doesn't work as expected, flag it here. Example: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "Gradle cache must be cleaned after Tuist changes or builds silently use stale artifacts"} Store facts that help future sessions, not notes about this one. Wrong: "Build failed because of stale cache." Right: "Gradle cache must be cleaned after Tuist changes." One insight per call. Persists across sessions, gets priority in brief() and recall(). Returns related knowledge. Required params: "lobe", "observation".

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The gotcha. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: convention
tools.description: When you notice a pattern the codebase follows, record it here. For personal style rules, use prefer() instead. Example: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "All ViewModels use StateFlow for UI state. LiveData is banned."} Store facts that help future sessions, not notes about this one. Wrong: "Migrated to StateFlow." Right: "All ViewModels use StateFlow." One insight per call. Persists across sessions, surfaces in brief() and recall(). Returns related knowledge. Required params: "lobe", "observation".

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The convention. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: When you understand how something works — architecture, dependencies, module boundaries — store it here. Catch-all for knowledge not covered by gotcha/convention. Example: {"lobe": "default", "observation": "Payments module depends on auth for tokens only, no other cross-module dependency"} Store facts that help future sessions, not actions you took or bugs you fixed. Wrong: "Fixed the null pointer in UserService." Right: "UserService.getUser() returns null when session expires — callers must handle this." One insight per call. Persists across sessions. Returns related knowledge. Required params: "lobe", "observation".

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The observation. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: prefer
tools.description: When the user corrects you or states how they want things done, record it here. Example: {"rule": "Never use !! operator"} or {"rule": "Use Anvil for DI", "lobe": "default"} Highest trust level. Persists across sessions, surfaced in every brief(). Omit lobe for global preferences; add lobe to scope to one project. Required param: "rule".

rule.description: The preference or rule. Write naturally.

lobe.description: Optional. Scope this preference to a specific lobe. Omit for global. Available: default

tools.name: fix
tools.description: When a stored entry is wrong or outdated, correct or delete it. IDs appear in brief/recall/gotchas/conventions results. Example: {"id": "gotcha-3f7a", "correction": "Updated text"} to replace, or {"id": "gotcha-3f7a"} to delete. Required param: "id". Pass "correction" to update; omit to delete.

id.description: Entry ID (e.g. gotcha-3f7a, conv-5c9b, gen-a2d1, pref-8e4f).

correction.description: New text to replace the entry content. Omit entirely to delete the entry.

lobe.description: Optional. Searches all lobes if omitted. Available: default

tools.name: memory_bootstrap
tools.description: First time with a new codebase — scans repo structure, README, and build system to seed initial memory. Run once per project. Example: {"lobe": "my-project"} or {"lobe": "new-project", "root": "/path/to/repo"} to auto-create lobe.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name. If the lobe doesn't exist yet, also pass "root" to auto-create it. Available lobes: default

root.description: Absolute path to the repo root. Required only when the lobe does not exist yet — the server will add it to memory-config.json automatically.

budgetMB.description: Storage budget in MB for the new lobe (default: 2). Only used when auto-creating a lobe via "root".
